case.description: 2-D static free droplet, hexagonal lattice, single phase, gravity off
case.note: sigma is 10x water deliberately: compresses capillary time so the droplet equilibrates inside the step budget. reference_pa = sigma/R = 7.2/0.02 = 360 Pa.

definition_classes.absolute_instant: p_core read as absolute pressure at a single time snapshot; ambient reference = 0 Pa. Forbidden by m2971 P2 (snapshot sits inside the breathing-mode noise band).
definition_classes.absolute_time_avg: p_core absolute, averaged over the tail window of the run. The definition adopted by m2971 P2 as the only publishable reading.
definition_classes.band: p_core minus a shell/interface band value (p_core - p_shell, p_center - p(0.80-0.95R), bandB). Confounded: the shell band lies in the free-surface density-deficit region, so the measured value is dominated by an artefact the law does not contain.
definition_classes.plateau: p_plateau(r<0.6R) - p_ambient(r>1.0R). Correct in principle, but in this configuration the plateau carries a large fluctuation (see plateau_std) because the interior is on the EOS pressure floor.

summary.evidence_grade_reason: Authoritative reading is -34.0% against sigma/R = 360 Pa, far outside the 15% platform bar and outside the 3% publication bar. The residual is a free-surface pressure closure defect (Tait clamp p>=0 cannot carry sigma/R on a -6%..-31% density-deficit shell), not a surface-tension discretisation defect: the cut-force identity (global force) is inside 15%.
